sources.source: Kishimoto and Tamura, Nuclear Physics A 163, 100-112 (1971)
sources.observed: OpenAlex closed/no repository full text/no OA location; ScienceDirect and CORE HTTP 403; IA Scholar verification page; searches yielded no lawful full-text copy. Abstract promises compact quadrupole-phonon CFP construction; exact E2 coverage cannot be determined.

sources.source: Arima and Iachello, Annals of Physics 99, 253-317 (1976)
sources.observed: Publisher HTTP 403; both original and 2000 republication have no OpenAlex OA location. Groningen reprint record gives an abstract but no full text. Yale author bibliography gives citation only. Abstract covers analytic energies/transitions; exact E2 coverage remains undetermined.

sources.source: Iachello and Arima, The Interacting Boson Model (CUP, 1987)
sources.access: read: authorized partial Google Books preview, especially pp.45-46; complete book inaccessible
sources.observed: Publisher chapter PDF redirects to access/abstract page. Preview pages 45-46 read visually: Eq.2.101 states general reduced d-dagger matrix-element problem; Table2.9 explicitly restricts both missing labels to zero and gives near-stretched L=2n_d,2n_d-2,2n_d-3 etc. This does not display fixed-low-L families at arbitrary seniority/trio count. Pages27-28 explicitly unavailable; no preview limit circumvented.

Metadata confirms gamma-unstable surface-vibration wavefunctions; publisher HTTP403, unauthenticated public text endpoint HTTP400, no OpenAlex repository full text. No formula-level comparison possible.

sources.source: Rowe, Turner and Repka, Journal of Mathematical Physics 45, 2761-2784 (2004)

sources.source: Castanos, Chacon, Frank and Moshinsky, Journal of Mathematical Physics 20, 35-44 (1979)
sources.observed: AIP and CORE HTTP403; UNAM record supplies abstract only; no OpenAlex OA location. Abstract concerns Casimir matrix elements, transformation brackets and numerical reduced-O(5) symbols, not an inspectable all-v E2 table.

University of Minnesota abstract explicitly bounds d-boson tables by n<=7. Publisher HTTP403 and no OpenAlex OA location. Search hit OSTI4454865 is a 1967 institutional progress report, not the requested article, and was not passed off as its full text. Finite tabulation overlaps small E2 instances but does not itself settle all v.

sources.access: read: public preview index/snippets only; relevant full pages inaccessible

No login, account switch or preview-limit bypass used. Therefore the actual low-L arbitrary-v formula tables could not be checked.

interpretation: This is a lawful-access exhaustion record, not certification that E2 was previously unsolved. Missing primary full texts remain a blocking prior-art gap.
